title: LogRecord
description: One line one of a stack's services wrote. The launcher removes from it each secret value the launcher generated or read; anything else the service wrote is the client's to handle. The launcher keeps no copy.

service.description: The role whose container wrote the line, as semiont status names it.

stream.description: Which of the container's streams the line was on.

receivedAt.description: When the launcher read the line, in RFC 3339 with its fraction: a container's own lines carry the time it wrote them, if any.
